name: Serdexmethylphenidate
summary: Serdexmethylphenidate (SDX) is a prodrug of dexmethylphenidate created by the pharmaceutical company Zevra Therapeutics. The compound was first approved by the FDA as one of the active ingredients in Azstarys for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children, adolescents, and adults in March 2021.

pharmacology.text: Serdexmethylphenidate (SDX) is a prodrug of dexmethylphenidate created by the pharmaceutical company Zevra Therapeutics.

uses.text: The compound was first approved by the FDA as one of the active ingredients in Azstarys for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children, adolescents, and adults in March 2021.

sideEffects.en: Common effects are those of methylphenidate: loss of appetite, sleeplessness, headache, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, anxiety and irritability. Stimulants can be misused and can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用和派醋甲酯相同：食慾減退、失眠、頭痛、心跳加快、血壓升高、焦慮和易怒。興奮劑可能被濫用並導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用和派醋甲酯相同：食欲减退、失眠、头痛、心跳加快、血压升高、焦虑和易怒。兴奋剂可能被滥用并导致依赖。

fact.en: Serdexmethylphenidate has an amino acid attached to dexmethylphenidate, which the lower gut slowly cuts off. That delay is why the capsule it comes in can cover a whole school day.
fact.zh: Serdexmethylphenidate 是在右旋派醋甲酯上接一個胺基酸，由下段腸道慢慢切除。這段延遲讓含有它的膠囊能覆蓋整個上學日。
fact.zhHans: Serdexmethylphenidate 是在右旋派醋甲酯上接一个胺基酸，由下段肠道慢慢切除。这段延迟让含有它的胶囊能覆盖整个上学日。
